# trino_tables Data Source

Lists the tables and views in one schema of a Trino catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "trino_tables" "sales" {
  catalog = "hive"
  schema  = "sales"

  name_prefix = "order_"
  table_type  = "BASE TABLE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Catalog containing the schema.
- `schema` (String) Schema whose tables should be listed.

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) Only return tables whose name starts with this prefix. Matching is case-insensitive.
- `table_type` (String) Only return tables of this type, for example BASE TABLE or VIEW. Matching is case-insensitive.

### Read-Only

- `tables` (Attributes List) Tables in the schema, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tables))

<a id="nestedatt--tables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tables`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Table name.
- `table_type` (String) Table type as reported by information_schema, for example BASE TABLE or VIEW.
